column1: # config/cast_views.tsv: the cast sites the consolidation gate (tools/struct_twins.py --gate, Phase 3.45 T8) accepts as casts.
# One row per (source, ctype): source = a T14 source key (docs/ops/p345-t14-source-census.md), ctype = the cast type as casts.tsv spells it,
# form C|P|I|X|M. cause: REINTERP (the one storage is read as two views: cites both views, path:line or <binary>/0x<addr>) |
# WALL residual:<CLASS> attempt1:<...> attempt2:<...> (CLASS one of restruct's X classes, docs/levers.md section 4). Every cite must hold
# (the line names the ctype; the address is a symbol of that binary) and the row must have a current site, else the gate FAILs.
